mapper.select: SELECT id, server_url, monitoring_enabled, updated_at FROM relay_setting WHERE id = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO relay_setting (id, server_url, monitoring_enabled, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{serverUrl}, #{monitoringEnabled}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE server_url = VALUES(server_url), monitoring_enabled = VALUES(monitoring_enabled), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
